# <a id="tag-1"></a><a id="tag-2"></a>Warpers

### Description

A Warper is a type of mage that prefers to deal in magic that alters the
fabric of space and time. They specialise in the schools of [Conveyance](m_convey.md),
[Divination](m_divin.md) and [Temporal](m_tempo.md) magic.

### Starting Stat Modifiers

| Strength | -5 |
| Intelligence | +3 |
| Wisdom | +0 |
| Dexterity | +1 |
| Constitution | -2 |
| Charisma | +1 |
| Hit Die | +d0 |
| Spell Points | +50% |
| Exp Penalty | 30% |
